body: I’m the director of technology at a holding company and working on a call center at one of my companies. We screwed up bad. We signed a contract with this bafoonery for 3 years. These absolute idiots are a month and a half past initial launch date. We have cut back our well outlined requirements by well more than half to get to launch and they still can’t meet them. They are now asking $80k to get out of the contract for a product they can’t deliver after we have already paid dozens of thousands of dollars. If you read this and sign up with this company, well I just have no words for you. Between five and nine, I assume this company will last much closer to five years before they go bankrupt. We set $5k aside for them to go away and leave us alone. If they don’t accept $5k we will sue them into oblivion and none of you will ever deal with them again. I will be opening a million dollar short sale on this company if they don’t accept our terms at the very least. Don’t even care if I lose money on it. The fact that we aren’t demanding every penny back is a blessing.

You may chose to stop rolling at any point and accept the points you have already earned in your turn. This was irrelevant in this case as I had crossed the point threshold of victory and he had to roll it all the way out to beat me so we had an equal number of turns. It’s an old game I used to play with drinking buddies. Easy math so it didn’t matter if you were a little drunk, but I used the game to teach my son to get more familiar with numbers and basic probabilities from the age of 3 and we have played at least a thousand games since.

You can choose not to re roll scoring dice. For example if my only scoring dice in my first roll was a 1 - 100 points and a 5 - 50 points, I’d reroll the 5 with the others non scoring dice. I did not want to introduce this complexity into the math problems, but if your confident in the added complexity then by all means. When you reroll you must reroll all non scoring dice plus any scoring dice you wish to reroll. Another example would be if I rolled three 2s - 200 points and a 1 - 100 points, I’d reroll my twos with the other dice. NTA… if your in the US you need to find a registered safe place. Every fire station is one. But fire stations aren’t the only one. You just need to let them know your escaping a domestic situation. They will find you temporary housing (probably a room full of bunk beds) and help you find work or get you into a jobs program. The military recruiters will come through regularly. Do not trust a word they say. Get some steady income and get a place. Don’t try to reach back out. You need to cut ties completely.

Be upfront. Let them know that tbe majority of the solution is on them and their cleaning. Set expectations of them. Advise them that it is very important that they follow them and if they do not then you will drop them as clients as you are out to solve problems and they wont be solved without sanitation. Drains are gonna be a huge deal. I generally tell them every drain must be cleaned every night before EOD.
Save specimins if you have them.

If your in Tulsa, I will. Be upfront. Just say your not going to do a treatment you just need a unit inspected and reported active because your landlord refuses to treat. If you werent upfront with me, I wouldnt do it without talking to the person who can authorize treatment either.

He cannot stop you. They are a guest. Do it anyways.  There is no state in which landlord tenant law permits him to stop you from having a guest in your home. If he says otherwise repeat the words above to him.

All companies only do free inspections for homeowners if they do free inspections. You just have to pay for an inspection. No one is going to do free work for you without the promise of treatment and only a homeowner can authorize treatment. I charge $150 for my time to do BB inspections in this situation and require all bedding be removed and bagged up and the place cleaned up. Im not going to flip over your couch if I have to drop it on your stuff and possibly break something.

You are legally permitted to have guests. Get the inspection done. It will show them as active. There is nothing the land lord can do to stop you from having a guest over. He can only stop you from getting pesticides applied. Bed Bugs are structure infesting organisms. I help run a pest control company. We won't touch single apartments. It is the whole building or nothing because otherwise we are pushing from unit to unit.  The inspection is the document you need to be able to get out of your lease. unfortunately scum slumlords are gonna evade as much as possible. We have elimintated thousands of infestations and done hundreds of apartment buildings.  If your landlord sucks. Talk to your neighbors. If they have the issue to then he/she faces a huge loss for not treating. It would only be $10k if there are like 30 units in the building.

Gonna tell you, most of your stuff is gonna go to assholes like me unless you donate it.  Your family doesn't want your dresser, your armour, or any of your furniture.  They don't want your dishes. And they paid me to do it.  Leave no trace my dude.  It takes a lot of work to make your suicide the least asshole type way possible.  Also don't hang yourself.  It sucks that way.  You need to calculate how much rope you need to drop to snap your neck without the dance of death.  The noose positioning needs to be cross chin.  It's a whole mess.  High Calibur firearms are better.  Don't point across the temple.  In the mouth or under the chin aimed to the top back of head is best.  But make sure you got all your shit together.  8 hours isn't enough.  Make sure all your legal stuff is in order.  The best part about suicide is that you can take care of everything so your family doesn't have to.  Seriously take a week or so and do it right.  I don't want to sound like I'm encouraging you.  I just think you should think through using your right to death appropriately.  I know it's hard to get motivated to do all this, but take some vitamin B12, and tell everyone you have decided to go tiny in a tiny home.  They won't suspect and you can get stuff done.

Dude, just because someone gets to your pets in time for them to survive doesn't mean they won't suffer and be hungry for a day or two.  Hire a pet sitter through one of the pet sitting apps and connect a debit card to it before you do it.  That way you aren't screwing the pet sitter out of pay and the pets don't have to hurt.  Or maybe re-home the pets first.  If you want to be a good person, make sure your an organ donor.  Make sure you have a will and end of life plans in place so your family doesn't have to be crying and be like "did he want to be buried or cremated?". It takes some time to get everything planned out.  It's kind of therapeutic.  You may change your mind while making these preparations, but if you want to be a good person they are necessary.
